# India Legal Templates

> Open-source (CC0) Indian-law legal templates for startups and enterprises, in Markdown with YAML front matter. Not legal advice: every template is an AI-assisted draft pending advocate review unless its review_status says otherwise.

How to use these files:

- Each template.md starts with YAML front matter. `fields` lists every {{placeholder}} with a label, type and example; ask the user for any value you do not have instead of inventing it.
- Lines starting with `> **Drafting note:**` are guidance for the drafter. Follow them, then remove them from the final document.
- `[OPTION A: ... / OPTION B: ...]` marks alternative clauses; choose one with the user.
- Never remove or resolve a `[verify]` point silently; list them for the user's advocate.
- Tell the user the result must be reviewed by an advocate and stamped under the applicable State Stamp Act.

- [Catalogue (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/catalog.json): metadata and fields for every template
- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Web form](https://aicodedecode.github.io/legal-templates-india/): fill any template in the browser and download .docx

## Startup Core

- [Advisor Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/advisor-agreement/template.md): Agreement engaging a startup advisor in India, covering services, time commitment, equity or cash compensation with vesting, IP and confidentiality.
- [Consultancy Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/consultancy-agreement/template.md): Agreement engaging an independent consultant or contractor in India, with fees, GST and TDS, s.19-compliant IP assignment, confidentiality and arbitration.
- [Employment Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/employment-agreement/template.md): Full employment agreement for a managerial or professional employee in India, aligned with the Labour Codes, State Shops and Establishments Acts, DPDP Act and s.27 ICA.
- [Founders' Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/founders-agreement/template.md): Agreement among the co-founders of an Indian private limited company covering roles, shareholding, reverse vesting, leaver terms, IP, decision-making and exit.
- [Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/ip-assignment-agreement/template.md): Confirmatory and prior-inventions IP assignment by a founder, employee or contractor to an Indian company, compliant with s.19 Copyright Act and s.68 Patents Act.
- [Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/mutual-nda/template.md): Two-way confidentiality agreement for Indian parties exploring a business relationship, with AI-training restrictions and arbitration.
- [Offer Letter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/offer-letter/template.md): Offer of employment for an Indian company setting out role, CTC breakdown, joining date, probation and conditions precedent, to be followed by a full employment agreement.
- [One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/one-way-nda/template.md): Disclosing-party-friendly confidentiality agreement for sharing a company's information with a vendor, partner, investor or candidate in India.

## Commercial & Enterprise

- [Distribution Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/distribution-agreement/template.md): Appointment of a buy-sell distributor for products in a defined Indian territory, with exclusivity options, targets, competition-law and consumer-law safeguards.
- [Master Services Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/master-services-agreement/template.md): Provider-leaning but balanced framework agreement for technology and IT services delivered under individual Statements of Work.
- [SaaS Subscription Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/saas-subscription-agreement/template.md): B2B software-as-a-service terms between a provider and an enterprise customer, with order forms, AI-feature, DPDP and exit provisions.
- [Service Level Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/service-level-agreement/template.md): Service level schedule for SaaS or managed services: availability, maintenance, support severity matrix, service credits and chronic-failure exit.
- [Statement of Work](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/statement-of-work/template.md): Project-level Statement of Work issued under a Master Services Agreement, covering scope, deliverables, milestones, fees, acceptance and change control.
- [Vendor Agreement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/vendor-agreement/template.md): Customer-leaning procurement framework for buying goods and/or services from a supplier through purchase orders, with MSMED, Labour Code and DPDP terms.

## Privacy & Web

- [Cookie and Tracking Technologies Notice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/cookie-notice/template.md): Notice explaining cookies, SDKs and similar technologies on an Indian website or app, with consent and withdrawal under the DPDP Act, 2023.
- [Data Processing Agreement (DPDP Act, 2023)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/data-processing-agreement/template.md): Data Fiduciary to Data Processor agreement under section 8(2) of the DPDP Act, 2023, covering security, breach, CERT-In, transfers, audit and liability.
- [Generative AI Acceptable Use Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/ai-acceptable-use-policy/template.md): Internal policy governing employees' use of generative AI tools in India: approved tools, prohibited inputs, human review, IP, labelling, DPDP and security.
- [Privacy Notice (DPDP Act, 2023)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/privacy-policy/template.md): Standalone, itemised privacy notice for an Indian website or app acting as a Data Fiduciary under the DPDP Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025.
- [Terms of Use (Website and App)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/terms-of-use/template.md): Website and app terms for an Indian platform, with IT Rules, 2021 content and grievance provisions and consumer-law safeguards.

## Fundraising & Corporate

- [Board Resolutions Pack for a Private Company](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/board-resolutions/template.md): Ten commonly used board resolutions for an Indian private company in certified-true-copy format, with the enabling section, quorum and filing notes for each.
- [Employee Stock Option Plan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/esop-plan/template.md): Employee Stock Option Plan for an unlisted Indian company under s.62(1)(b) Companies Act and Rule 12, with grant letter, exercise notice and shareholder resolution.
- [Shareholders' Agreement (Post Priced Round)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/shareholders-agreement/template.md): Shareholders' agreement among an Indian private company, its founders and investors after a priced CCPS round, with governance, transfer, exit and FEMA provisions.
- [Term Sheet for Seed / Series A Investment (CCPS)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/term-sheet/template.md): Term sheet for a priced seed or Series A round in an Indian private company issuing CCPS; binding only on confidentiality, exclusivity, costs and governing law.
- [iSAFE Note – CCPS Subscription Agreement with Valuation Cap and Discount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/isafe-note/template.md): India-adapted SAFE: early-stage investment through CCPS that convert at the next qualified financing at a valuation cap and/or discount.

## HR Policies

- [Employee Handbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/employee-handbook/template.md): Concise but complete employee handbook for an Indian company covering conduct, leave, remote work, IT, data protection, anti-bribery, POSH, grievances, discipline and exit.
- [Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicodedecode/legal-templates-india/main/templates/posh-policy/template.md): Workplace sexual harassment policy under the POSH Act, 2013 and Rules: Internal Committee, complaint, conciliation, inquiry, interim relief, appeal and complaint form.
